# Feature flags

Config keys that switch a group of tools on or off. While a key is off the tools in its
row are not offered to clients at all, and `capabilities()` reports them under
`hidden_tools` with the key that would bring them back.

| Config key | Default | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| [`agenda_enabled`](config.md#agenda_enabled) | on | [`alerts`](tools.md#alerts), [`alerts_check`](tools.md#alerts_check), [`schedule_list`](tools.md#schedule_list), [`schedule_run`](tools.md#schedule_run) |
| [`codigo_enabled`](config.md#codigo_enabled) | on | [`graph_changed_notes`](tools.md#graph_changed_notes), [`graph_notes`](tools.md#graph_notes), [`vault_note_code`](tools.md#vault_note_code) |
| [`digestao_enabled`](config.md#digestao_enabled) | on | [`digest_transcripts`](tools.md#digest_transcripts) |
| [`envelhecimento_enabled`](config.md#envelhecimento_enabled) | off | [`vault_forget_sweep`](tools.md#vault_forget_sweep), [`vault_note_feedback`](tools.md#vault_note_feedback) |
| [`fatos_enabled`](config.md#fatos_enabled) | on | [`vault_facts`](tools.md#vault_facts) |
| [`historico_enabled`](config.md#historico_enabled) | on | [`vault_note_diff`](tools.md#vault_note_diff), [`vault_note_history`](tools.md#vault_note_history), [`vault_note_restore`](tools.md#vault_note_restore) |
| [`livro_enabled`](config.md#livro_enabled) | on | [`usage_report`](tools.md#usage_report) |
| [`passagem_enabled`](config.md#passagem_enabled) | off | [`handoff_cancel`](tools.md#handoff_cancel), [`handoff_create`](tools.md#handoff_create), [`handoff_list`](tools.md#handoff_list), [`handoff_pickup`](tools.md#handoff_pickup) |
| [`recordacao_enabled`](config.md#recordacao_enabled) | on | [`recall_stats`](tools.md#recall_stats) |
| [`referencias_enabled`](config.md#referencias_enabled) | on | [`vault_dead_refs`](tools.md#vault_dead_refs) |
| [`sonho_enabled`](config.md#sonho_enabled) | on | [`dream_apply`](tools.md#dream_apply), [`dream_dismiss`](tools.md#dream_dismiss), [`dream_findings`](tools.md#dream_findings), [`dream_run`](tools.md#dream_run) |
| [`web_search_enabled`](config.md#web_search_enabled) | off | [`search_web`](tools.md#search_web) |

Tools that need the optional `[graph]` extra (tree-sitter) are hidden when it is not
installed: `graph_build`, `graph_build_bg`, `graph_preview`, `graph_hook_install`.
